result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends mainly on where your employees are based, how many people you pay, and whether you want to manage payroll yourself or automate everything.

If you're running a UK small business, I would focus on software that handles **PAYE, National Insurance, pension auto-enrolment, HMRC submissions (RTI), payslips and year-end reporting**\.

I wouldn't automatically choose the cheapest option: reliable HMRC compliance and straightforward payroll processing are worth paying a little extra for.

## My top UK payroll software recommendations

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll**

(Best overall standalone option)

- Good for small and growing businesses.
- HMRC reporting and pension support.
- Employee self-service options.
- Published starting price around £12/month for five employees.

Website: [Sage UK](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/)

---

![BrightPay Standard + Connect to BrightPay Cloud FAQs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/w4enxIyDycO7AUK2q9MSigbCrvpztFs7Z_H6w-w2lUCrViF19Xl4mmIDmq49uY9OqMEZyacb1cfZ96kB1itVQG4Um52YB5FfIcdxh61NUZmjo-ZiQQw-o3a64YCd83vlmMVrUh7TPEkE6dshtPXZgYIC-gPHTX5mwqy58KHGJgCW85IZxwm6G0figtCehl5s?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay**

(Best dedicated payroll software)

- Strong payroll-specific functionality.
- Good pension integration.
- Particularly useful for accountants and businesses managing payroll in-house.
- Current cloud pricing is quotation-based.

Website: [BrightPay](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Xero – AccountKit Support Center](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/HOFZdHQfaXHdQ0Jl6FhQm1ZL8WDa2JXXY2s_IDNQw6_ClmY--iV2XW1k6Glaj1ICzU7IfOAztiKsPODuDYTSIw6PRmUslgzmZ5aMlPuGROKkGMtSJzGnCUzu5B8zEx6lZO3rd6Y_GILZvoN2_MXkKzeqqLSGOUSO0lv-UiE7fZFfvbCSDizWo5sdMixvhee4?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero Payroll**

(Best if you use Xero accounting)

- Payroll integrated with bookkeeping.
- Employee leave and payslips.
- HMRC reporting and pension support.
- Avoids entering payroll figures twice.

Website: [Xero UK](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![QuickBooks Payroll Workshop Coming up at Landmark - Landmark CPAs](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EpjoKgv3qp1QFtZSwa4jOSAGoy_bpW7Sg9OVIiK8-oa8UMuOdZRCQiQ9wIV6A0EP90E_oKZqlgba5b3V-cBIKwbDpfEpoiDXWBpJxyQbp0PrvFWqMD5tYDybAbqob6mWzYEtZyXdxwg9oLN481huockY4Xh7GxIqIqUTHjoFCNUvsU8P9qXqQ0Z3Uur0cFsF?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. QuickBooks Payroll**

(Best for QuickBooks users)

- Payroll and accounting integration.
- Automated tax calculations and HMRC submissions.
- Pension support.
- Good for smaller teams.

Website: [QuickBooks UK](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/uk/)

---

![Employment Hero - Which HR Software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hoOMaIHHE1BVK8wWyswfFUWF-4zNLm2VTTf8I0IsZi71QvwwVg013JN6PZd_JzmKlLo5GMH1Nn9Dlq8Awe3_MYWQTya_RX2YJlpU2kxq0LmTpktkVrYam4C6Jqjid1iaOedcQ7rhD-uZbRDBcKqCEBszhJOC_eRUB4bTTF7gnOKcGZ7dKIuzDzdg-ruuRgJy?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Employment Hero**

(Best for HR and payroll together)

- Payroll alongside HR management.
- Employee records, leave and onboarding.
- Free payroll option advertised.
- Useful if you're planning to grow your team.

Website: [Employment Hero](https://employmenthero.com/uk/)

These recommendations reflect 2026 UK comparisons. ## Which would I choose?

My starting recommendation would be\:

- **Sage** if you want standalone payroll software.
- **BrightPay** if payroll processing is your main priority.
- **Xero** if you already use Xero for accounts.
- **Employment Hero** if you want HR and payroll together.

## Let me narrow it down to the best option for your business

There are three things I'd like to know\:

**1\. How many employees do you pay?**
